AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to be conducted through video conference in compliance with the Governor's and LA County Health Official's emergency orders. The meeting will be called to order at 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, November 23, 2021. The agenda for the special meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below along with instructions on how to attend the public meeting.
Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on Thursday, November 18, 2021 at 5:00 p.m.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's recommended measures to promote social distancing. All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85003410422
MEETING ID: 850 0342 0422
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 850 0341 0422#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda by simply utilizing the "Raise Hand" feature during the item under consideration. When called upon to speak please state your name for the record. Members of the public are not required to submit notification in advance.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
PUBLIC COMMENTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to State law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
NEW BUSINESS
1.
APPROVAL OF THE PALOS VERDES TENNIS CLUB’S 2022 PROPOSED OPERATING BUDGET, CAPITAL FUND BUDGET AND 10-YEAR CAPITAL INVESTMENT FUND FORECAST AND APPROVAL OF REVISED DUES FOR 2022.
Recommendation: that the City Council approve the Palos Verdes Tennis Club’s 2022 proposed operating and capital budgets and approve the revised dues as submitted by the PVTC.
Staff Report
2.
CONSIDERATION OF THE PROPOSED 2022 PALOS VERDES GOLF CLUB (PVGC) OPERATING, CAPITAL BUDGETS, CHANGES TO THE PVGC FEE SCHEDULE, AND OTHER MATTERS RELATED TO THE JEM PROGRAM AND ONGOING CAPITAL PROJECTS.
Recommendation: That the City Council (1) Approve the Operating and Capital Budgets; (2) Approve the proposed schedule of dues and fees (excluding the proposed JEM Family 21-34 fees until Council has an opportunity to review the Club's proposed JEM program modifications); (3) Review the Club's proposed changes to the JEM program at the January 12th, 2022 City Council meeting and that the Concession Agreement be amended within 90 days of the Council decision to reflect the changes; (4) Approve of an additional $350 thousand to the 2021 Capital Budget for completion of the Dining Room Renovation, and (5) Require that any expenditures of more than $15 thousand from the Contingency Funds be submitted to the City for approval prior to incurring the underlying obligation.
Staff Report
Revised Staff Report
ADJOURNMENT
i.
This City Council meeting can be viewed on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, and on the City’s website, not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2.  Dated this 18th day of November, 2021.
Carol Cowley, Interim City Clerk
